claims.exact_statement: Independent reconstruction accepts B05-A023-SEPARATED-TWO-CORE-U-IDENTITY-v1: for arbitrary genuine Boolean children on disjoint physical blocks and a fresh d-bit one-word selector, equation (2) of the B05 proof is the exact upper-set U identity, including deterministic and balanced endpoints.

Independent reconstruction accepts B05-A023-SEPARATED-HIERARCHY-PAYMENT-v1: for every finite fresh one-word selector tree with disjoint complete sibling variable sets and arbitrary genuine Boolean leaves, U(Froot)-sum_leaf w_leaf U(g_leaf)<=C_sep I_sel(Froot), with C_sep=3+4(1+2/e)/ln2+2/ln2+2/(e ln2)<16.964, independently of depth, rarity, leaf dimension, and the number of core changes.
hypotheses: disjoint complete variable sets across siblings
arbitrary genuine Boolean leaves retained by reach weight
does_not_prove: a universal bound on retained leaf U
claims.first_unproved_line: Control the signed upper-mass overlap defect when sibling Fourier coefficients share physical frequencies, without reusing pivotal events.
